baseline_literal: Both `IWorkflowEventIngress.AcceptAsync` overloads SHALL return `WorkflowEventAcceptanceResult`, the closed union of `Accepted`, `Duplicate`, and `Rejected(WorkflowEventAcceptanceRejection)`. `WorkflowEventAcceptanceRejection` SHALL be the closed union of `EventConflict`, `DirectInstanceNotFound`, `DirectInstanceTerminal`, `StartConflict(StartIdempotencyConflict)`, and `FanoutLimitExceeded`. Only `Accepted` and `Duplicate` SHALL mean OrcaCore durably owns the complete envelope and route intent and the broker MAY be acknowledged. A rejection SHALL commit neither ownership nor a partial fanout target set. Infrastructure, serialization, and cancellation failures SHALL complete exceptionally rather than masquerading as an acknowledgement-safe result. Event-identity deduplication SHALL precede current route-state evaluation, so an identical redelivery of an accepted event remains `Duplicate` after its target progresses or terminalizes.
